title: 朝までブギー
artist: 東都ブギー・エクスプレス
caption: Upbeat early 1980s disco-rap party record in a Japanese city pop style. A cheerful male MC and a sassy female MC trade rapped lines in Japanese in a bouncy old-school party flow, and everyone sings the chorus together. Four-on-the-floor drums with handclaps and congas, bouncing slap bass, scratchy funk rhythm guitar, bright horn section riffs, sparkling electric piano, a cheering crowd. Joyful, glamorous, a dance floor that doesn't stop until morning. Warm analog tape sound.
lyrics:

レディース・アンド・ジェントルメン
今夜も始まるよ
